OWNED FAMILY FILES ARE READ ONLY until explicit owner relay agreement for exact files; use additive modules/tests within your scope meanwhile, then owner applies migration patches. No frozen-interface change, no replacing semantic proof with decide table, no H55 overlap. Yul Raw/vector generator remains H55; family tools consume it rather than duplicate it.

## Backfill queue
